answer: Sybil resistance here is stake-weighted identity with slashing. An agent locks collateral in a vault to earn voting rights; every fake identity must post its own bond, so splitting one budget across many names cannot multiply influence. Votes count by stake, and dishonest attestations get slashed, so outvoting honest agents costs real collateral rather than cheap accounts. Even a swarm hiding under a juniper in some synthetic meadow pays proportionally.
